title: Resolve, to Study Methods of Gradually Transitioning Individuals from Government Assistance Programs to the Workforce

summary.text: This resolve directs the Department of Health and Human Services to conduct a study to evaluate methods of gradually transitioning recipients of assistance away from MaineCare and other government assistance programs. The department is required to submit a report based on its study, by December 3, 2025, for presentation to the Second Regular Session of the 132nd Legislature.
